_readme: Draft Nassington walk. [[c:...]] = cyan, not confirmed. Positions are guesses until recorded on site.
name: Back to the Black Horse

layers.essential_history: [[c:Back where you started, in a village that once had a royal hall.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Nassington's story runs from Roman farms to King Cnut and the Bishops of Lincoln.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:The King is waiting. Say who took the chessman.]]

directions_to_next: [[c:That's the end of the walk. Well done, detective!]]

puzzle.title: [[c:Who took the King's chessman?]]
puzzle.intro: [[c:Look through your evidence notebook, then make your accusation.]]
puzzle.question: [[c:Who took it, why, and where is it now?]]

fields.label: Why?
options: He lost a bet and was going to pay with it
fields.answer: He lost a bet and was going to pay with it

fields.label: Where is it now?
options: Hidden by the river, ready to take away
fields.answer: Hidden by the river, ready to take away

hints: [[c:Who was seen leaving with something under his cloak?]]
[[c:Whose buckle was on the river path?]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:It was Ulf. He lost a bet at dice and planned to pay his debt with the ivory king, so he hid it by the river ready to take away. The chessman is back on the board, and the King wins his game.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:You can solve this from your notebook alone.]]
